en.text:
Diamond Lance creates a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal on impact. Hitting an <link Elite or higher tier Combatant [#CombatantClassifications] /> creates 3 additional <stasis/>Stasis Crystals.

With a <stasis/>Stasis Super Ability equipped, spawn a <stasis/>Diamond Lance next to you by performing one of three actions:
• Stand behind a Rally Barricade and score a Kill or 3 Precision Hits within ? seconds of each
<bold OR />
• Reach 100% progress by landing hits with <stasis/>Stasis Weapons. Bodyshots grant 5% progress, and precision damage grants 12% progress
<bold OR />
• Score two <stasis/>Stasis Weapon kills

<stasis/>Diamond Lance damage is increased by 144%|253%|333%|389%|428%|455%|475% at 1|2|3... stacks of <stasis/>Frost Armor.

Slamming the <stasis/>Diamond Lance gives <stasis/>Frost Armor first, therefore always benefitting from the damage buff.

This exotic shares the cooldown of the <stasis/>Diamond Lance Aspect, but using the Aspect is not required.
